<DOCSTRING>
Returns a list of coordinates of un-hit cells.

This method is used to identify all cells that have not been hit by any player's shots. It iterates through all ships and collects the coordinates of cells that are still un-hit.
</DOCSTRING>

<DOCSTRING>
Args:
    self (object): The instance of the class containing the ships and their un-hit cells.

Returns:
    List[Tuple[int, int]]: A list of coordinates (row, column) of un-hit cells.
</DOCSTRING>
